en: Panoramic, monochrome postcard showing a hilly town with dense low buildings and several minarets, suggesting an Ottoman-era settlement. A main road runs through the center from the foreground into the town. There is printed caption text in French at the top left and right, and extensive handwritten text across the bottom margin. A circular seal or emblem appears on the left, and a modern watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed over the middle of the image.
